$comment: Template and slot contracts (D-038). The single source for which sections a page template accepts, in what order and how many. Read by src/templates/contract.mjs (validateComposition), the PageTemplate renderer, the Natural MCP server (validate_composition) and npm run check:templates. A composition is the data a page is built from: { template, slots: { <slotId>: [section, ...] } }. Personalised sources are allowed by the contract today; their reason label and demo come in a later release.

navigation.description: The site header: logo, shop links, search, account, wishlist and Bag.

hero.description: Full-bleed Hero image with a page intro below it: one H1, an optional line of Paragraph/Large and one action.

intro.description: A page intro: one H1 and an optional line of Paragraph/Large. Collection pages use it under their banner.

banner.description: A Banner Image Block. Decorative unless alt is given.

product-row.description: A titled row of Product Cards. Its source says where the products come from.

story.description: A Half-page Image Block with copy beside it: an H2, a paragraph and an optional action.

filters.description: The collection filter bar: price Range Slider, In stock only Toggle and the piece count.

load-more.description: Showing n of m pieces, with a Secondary Show more button.

product-gallery.description: The product's photos: the whole piece, a material close-up and a scale shot.

product-summary.description: Name, one-line story, price, options and Add to Bag.

product-details.description: Details, variation note, care and delivery, in the order DESIGN.md §2 sets.

curated.description: Chosen by a person for this page.

collection.description: Every piece in the current collection, filtered.

related.description: Pieces that share a material or collection with the current product.

recently-viewed.description: Pieces this shopper looked at recently.

because-you-bought.description: Pieces that go with something this shopper bought.

recommended.description: Pieces chosen for this shopper by a recommendation service.

personalization.$comment: Rules every personalised section must meet, whatever produced it.

homepage.name: Homepage
homepage.description: The front door: one hero, then a mix of product rows and studio stories.

rules.reason: A homepage shows at least one row of products.
Products come before stories, so the page opens on something to buy.
Two stories in a row read as a magazine, not a shop.

collection.name: Collection
collection.description: A category of pieces: banner, intro, filters, rows of products and Show more.

rules.reason: The first thing after the filters is what they filter.
Stories break up rows; they don't stack.
More than two stories bury the products.

product.name: Product page
product.description: One piece: gallery beside the summary, then the details, then related pieces.

rules.reason: Rows on a product page relate to the product or the shopper.
